title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.41296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Answer-level rewards cannot distinguish reasoning traces with equally correct outcomes. We study whether auxiliary trajectory preferences improve small-language-model self-improvement and transfer under limited supervision. We compare confidence-based (SC) and entropy-based metrics (UID-Conj.), which combines global entropy variation and local smoothness, through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. Online experiments adapt Qwen3-1.7B on 30 AIME problems without reference answers; offline experiments use historical AIME problems. UID-Conj. improves the online macro-average across the adaptation benchmark and three transfer benchmarks by 2.08 percentage points over unmodified TTRL. The strongest evidence comes from offline weighted SFT: UID-Conj. exceeds uniform weighting on the same response pool by 1.93 points, with a paired prompt-bootstrap 95\% CI of [0.44, 3.44]. Benefits are task-dependent: SC reward

translated_title: 基于辅助奖励的自我改进：从已验证的推理轨迹中学习并评估迁移能力
translated_abstract: 答案级别的奖励无法区分那些最终结果同样正确的推理轨迹。我们研究在有限监督条件下，辅助的轨迹偏好能否改进小语言模型的自我改进能力及其迁移性。我们比较了基于置信度的指标（SC）与基于熵的指标（UID-Conj.，其结合了全局熵变化与局部平滑度），并通过在线奖励增广与在正确回答上进行离线训练两种方式加以评估。在线实验在不使用参考答案的情况下，将Qwen3-1.7B适配到30道AIME题目上；离线实验则使用历史AIME题目。UID-Conj.在适配基准及三个迁移基准上的在线宏平均比未修改的TTRL提高了2.08个百分点。最有力的证据来自离线加权SFT：在同一回答池上，UID-Conj.比均匀加权高出1.93个百分点，配对prompt-bootstrap的95%置信区间为[0.44, 3.44]。其收益依赖于具体任务：SC奖励……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合全局熵变化与局部平滑度的辅助轨迹奖励指标UID-Conj.，在无需参考答案的条件下显著提升了小语言模型自我改进的适配性能与跨任务迁移能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an auxiliary trajectory reward metric, UID-Conj., which combines global entropy variation with local smoothness and significantly improves reference-answer-free self-improvement adaptation and cross-task transfer for small language models.
